classification.difficultyReason: Reverse bearings from diagrams. Part a is a single cointerior step. Part b needs a reflex-to-clockwise conversion and then a reverse bearing. The diagrams give the angles, so there are two short steps at most.

answer.worked:
The given $48^\circ$ is measured anticlockwise from north at $S$, so
$$\begin{align*}\text{Bearing of }R\text{ from }S&=360^\circ-48^\circ\\&=312^\circ\end{align*}$$
Reverse bearings differ by $180^\circ$.
$$\begin{align*}\text{Bearing of }S\text{ from }R&=312^\circ-180^\circ\\&=132^\circ\end{align*}$$

The given $245^\circ$ is measured anticlockwise from north at $R$, so
$$\begin{align*}\text{Bearing of }S\text{ from }R&=360^\circ-245^\circ\\&=115^\circ\end{align*}$$
Reverse bearings differ by $180^\circ$.
$$\begin{align*}\text{Bearing of }R\text{ from }S&=115^\circ+180^\circ\\&=295^\circ\end{align*}$$
